profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ GiggleFinance
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with over five years of professional experience specializing in software engineering, data engineering, and distributed systems. Currently at Giggle Finance I design, build, and maintain scalable backend and full-stack systems that power core financial workflows and products. I work closely with product, operations, and engineering leadership to define requirements, participate in architectural decision-making, and deliver robust RESTful APIs, services, and end-to-end features that are secure, observable, and highly reliable.

Previously at Living Security, I architected and optimize real-time ETL pipelines, multi-tenant data ingestion systems, and ClickHouse analytics infrastructure supporting 100K+ monitored users across 28+ enterprise security integrations.

Previously at TaskSuite, I built full-stack loan management systems, engineered high-volume data migration projects handling 2.7 million data points, and developed proprietary optimization algorithms that improved loan profitability while ensuring regulatory compliance. Recognized with the "Global Top Performer" award in 2024 for operational excellence and leadership in delivering critical client onboarding projects.

I hold a Master's degree in Computing and Data Science from Sam Houston State University with a specialization in Recurrent Neural Networks, and a Bachelor of Science in Electronics and Computer Engineering Technology. During my collegiate tenure, I was a two-time NCAA Division I National qualifier and Indoor/Outdoor conference champion in track and field. Academic honors include Dean's List (x4) and President's Honor Roll (x1).

My passion lies in building scalable, reliable data systems and leveraging modern technologies to solve complex engineering challenges. I specialize in Python, SQL, TypeScript, cloud infrastructure (AWS), and data pipeline architecture. I'm particularly interested in the intersection of data engineering, distributed systems, and real-time analytics in cybersecurity and fintech domains.

positions.title: Software Engineer II - Data
positions.description:
- Optimized ClickHouse analytics queries 4-10x using reverse lookup patterns and LIMIT N+1 elimination, reducing customer-facing activity lookups from 10s to <1s while supporting 100K+ users, enabling real-time security analytics dashboards
- Architected complete data ingestion system from scratch with Docker scheduler/worker services (ECS Fargate), Redis/BullMQ distributed queue, OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow supporting 28+ enterprise security integrations.
- Architected real-time 3-layer ETL system (Redis/BullMQ → NestJS workers → ClickHouse) processing 28+ enterprise security integrations, for ingestion-to-analytics workflows with multi-tenant entity resolution across 8 identifier types supporting 100K+ monitored users

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed and built full-stack, reliable, scalable, and maintainable, customer-facing loan management software for five major clients. Developed entire end-to-end architecture and infrastructure utilizing Python, JavaScript, SQL, PostgreSQL, Nginx, AWS EC2 and AWS RDS.
•	Imported and distributed approximately 2.7 million data points across six database tables which represented a $95 million loan book by engineering, orchestrating and executing a high-volume data migration project. Optimized the performance of the ETL process by utilizing SQL, NumPy, and Pandas; significantly reduced import execution time for the entire operation to just over eight minutes.
•	Orchestrated and developed a proprietary loan optimization algorithm that maximized repayment amounts, adhered to APR limits, and considered multiple variables including principal, contract dates, payment frequency, and interest accrual methods. Improved loan profitability significantly, and ensured regulatory compliance with this innovative solution.
•	Architected and implemented a comprehensive REST API utilizing Python’s Requests library which enabled seamless integration between clients and the loan management system. This design, functionality, implementation and documentation is now the standard API design for the company when exposing services to new clients.
•	Earned the “Global Top Performer” award for operational excellence for the year of 2024 from TaskSuite. Primarily for spearheading the end-to-end development, optimization, and substantial implementation of multiple critical onboarding projects and for presiding over the collaboration of a global, cross-functional team which ensured projects were successfully completed to meet approximately 15 clients’ requirements and overall satisfaction.
